name: Troll Falls winter walk & snowshoe, Kananaskis

description: A short forest walk or snowshoe (about 1.4 to 1.7 km) to a waterfall, rated Simple (Class 1) avalanche terrain in Alberta Parks' snowshoe brochure. The trail is usually icy in winter, so ice grippers often work better than snowshoes, and in deep winter the falls can freeze into an ice fall. Check current trail reports before you go.
seasonal: May be icy anytime from October to May, so bring micro-spikes (and poles). Stay behind the rockfall barricades near the falls.
